answer_2.quote: For objective metrics, we evaluate the intelligibility (WER, ↓), speaker similarity (SIM, ↑), and overall speech quality (UT-MOS , ↑).

answer_4.quote: For subjective metrics, we employ Comparative Mean Opinion Score (rated from -2 to 2) to evaluate naturalness (N-CMOS, ↑), use reading accuracy (Section 3.4) to evaluate intelligibility, and use A/B Testing to compare speaker similarity between the generated samples before and after intelligibility alignment.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators performed binary classification to determine if the speech accurately reads the text (reading accuracy), rated naturalness on a -2 to 2 scale (CMOS), and conducted A/B comparisons to judge speaker similarity.
